summary: The entries of such points are rational numbers of E whose infinite components lie in a compact set (C) and whose finite components lie in a compact set (h_c K(g) h_c⁻¹ in the lattice basis); E meets a compact subset of 𝔸_E in a finite set.

steps.claim: A finite superset: for every infinite place v and indices i, j, consider the compact image of C × GL(Ô) under p ↦ (((p₁)_v)_{ij}·basisScale(f i)/basisScale(f j) at the infinite places, ((B h_c) p₂ (B h_c)⁻¹)_{f(i) f(j)}) (B = latBasis); E ⊂ 𝔸_E is a lattice of covolume one, so only finitely many x ∈ E lie in the preimage of this compact set, and their images x ↦ Φ_v(x)·(scale) form a finite set. The product over v, i, j of these finite sets is a finite set of tuples of matrices.
